V62 matched room color and shelf, gray paper surround, photographic dark-road street, separate figure, pivoting supports and short-lived localized sparks. V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

V63 calibrated portrait push, pre-rolled destruction, shared perspective camera and five conductor spans, bound salvage wires and darker terrain.

Bundled locally inside Blank Composition.
limitations: Specialized character and prop surface tools; no general topology editor or cloth simulator.
Body targets and garment transfer do not establish finished anatomy, tailored clothing or collision-free fitting.
Brush picking is triangle based and radius uses bind space. Weight assignment is per vertex, not a brush stroke.
Correctives use local Euler drivers; extreme shapes and combinations require visual review.
Native JSON preserves all workshop data. GLB exports evaluated mesh and sampled transforms; changing procedural materials or driven geometry may differ externally.
Source footage remains an illustrative approximation, not an exact match.

tears.title: Let the picture through.
tears.description: Little tears grow into the next scene.

zoom.title: Move into the shoulder.
zoom.description: A close camera move becomes a doorway.

light.title: Bring the desk to light.
light.description: The background falls away. The lamp wakes up.

fire.title: Build the fire.
fire.description: Living flames, with their own motion and glow.

people.title: Reveal the people.
people.description: Two separate silhouettes emerge behind the flames.

outdoor.title: A new scene unfolds.
outdoor.description: First a figure, then the sky, feet and the world around them.

blur.title: Choose what feels soft.
blur.description: The generated pictures stay sharp. Blur is a separate effect.

camera.title: Rise through the scene.
camera.description: People move past the camera while the clouds drift left.

finish.title: Pull into the next chapter.
finish.description: Logos emerge. Red meets blue. A brief lens pull ends the scene.

value.label: Fill silhouette with image or color

value.shelterLetterText:
Adi,

I do not believe you have
the character to lead our
company. While I am away,
my wife will represent me
in all decisions regarding
the business. This is not
a request.

Rudi
